messages:
ana: Quick sync — we need to finalize the emitter/sampling plan for the per-model SLO panels (P50/P95/P99 + TTFT + tokens/sec). Running into conflicting constraints: infra wants low cardinality, runtime needs route-level labels for routing QoS, and console needs stable series for dashboards.

devin: Agree. From runtime: we can emit per-request metrics with labels {model, route, variant, region, outcome}. Problem: variant+route expands cardinality fast. Recommend sampling at 1% for low-volume routes, 100% for critical routes.

mike: 1% sampling is fine but we need to be explicit about which fields are high-cardinality. `request_id`, `user_id`, `prompt_hash` must never be labels. Keep labels limited to the set you mentioned. Also prefer `model_family` vs full model hash for dashboards.

sara: UX note: dashboards need consistent P95 series; if sampling varies across routes/time we’ll see noisy charts. Can we attach a `sampling_rate` tag so panels can autoscale the confidence bar? Or compute scaled counts server-side?

devin: We can attach `sampling_rate` label but most TSDBs (prometheus/metrics-mesh) treat tags as part of identity — adds cardinality. Alternative: emit a companion metric `metric_sampling_rate{model,route}=0.01` as a separate gauge, not a label on the histogram. Then console can query e.g. `histogram_quantile(0.95, rate(latency_bucket[5m])) / sampling_rate_gauge` when needed.

mike: That works. Also propose these emitter-level conventions:
```
metric names: ri_latency_ms_bucket|_sum|_count, ri_ttft_ms, ri_tokens_sec
labels: model, route, region, deployment_tier
no labels: customer_id, prompt_hash, request_id
emit companion gauge: ri_sampling_rate{model,route,region}
```

ron: For quota enforcement and per-route throttling we need tokens/sec aggregated per-route and per-model-family, and a separate timeseries for "spillover" (requests routed to fallback model). Can we add `route_outcome` label with values {ok, throttled, fallback}?

devin: `route_outcome` we can add, but again cardinality. If we keep it limited to 3 values it's fine. We'll add it only on the aggregated metrics, not on raw latency buckets. So: emit `ri_route_outcome_counter{model,route,route_outcome}` and `ri_tokens_sec` without outcome.

ana: minor correction — my name is ana, not anna :) Also: action item list?

ana: action items I heard: 1) runtime: implement companion sampling gauge + sampling config (devin) 2) infra: finalize metric name/label spec + cardinality guardrails (mike) 3) console: prototype panel that uses sampling gauge to show adjusted P95 and a CI band (sara) 4) quotas: add `route_outcome` counter for throttled/fallback tracking (ron)

devin: I'll open a PR with emitter changes and a small compatibility shim: default sampling 1% except for routes in `critical_routes` set (100%). PR will include example `promql` snippets.

mike: I'll add the label whitelist & cardinality alert (we'll rate-limit new unique label values) and draft a collector-side dedupe for near-identical route names.

sara: I'll mock the dashboard panels tomorrow — want one row per model_family, columns: P50, P95, P99, TTFT, tokens/sec, and a small sparkline of sampling rate. Panel will gray out if sampling_rate < 0.005.

ron: I'll wire quota telemetry to the `ri_route_outcome_counter` and add a daily report of fallback counts per-customer.

observability-bot: New ticket created: METRICS-4823 "Per-route SLO emitter + sampling gauge" assigned to dev-team.
deploy-bot: Deploy queued for runtime emitter changes — safe window Mon 03:00 UTC.

ana: cool. can everyone drop their PR/ticket links in this thread when available? I'll consolidate into the spec doc and schedule a short handoff sync on Mon after deploy window is confirmed. :calendar: :white_check_mark:

devin: PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/2108 (draft)

mike: Spec: https://docs.internal.redwood/metrics/label-guidelines.md (WIP)

sara: Dashboard mock: https://figma.com/file/xyz (private)

ana: thanks — meeting invite for Mon 03:30 UTC once deploy window confirmed.

devin: one more note — TTFT calculation: we should define it as `time_from_request_received_to_first_token_emitted` and expose both ms and a bucketed histogram. Will include in PR.

mike: Agreed. also add `deployment_tier` label (hosted/dedicated/private) so we can filter enterprise-only traffic.

ana: perfect. End of thread for now, will follow up with consolidated spec.
